observed_data.verbatim_request: "Project Title: 100% Automated Hands-Free & Bulletproof Pan-European WooCommerce Store: WWW.EUROMALLS.EU.COM Project Description: PRIMARY GOAL: A 100% AUTOMATED, HANDS-FREE, BULLETPROOF ONLINE STORE FOR WWW.EUROMALLS.EU.COM We are building WWW.EUROMALLS.EU.COM into a 100% Automated, Hands-Free, Bulletproof Pan-European Online Digital Shopping Mall requiring ZERO manual intervention from the moment a customer clicks "Buy" on WWW.EUROMALLS.EU.COM to supplier payment, warehouse dispatch, customs/tax compliance, and tracking delivery. WWW.EUROMALLS.EU.COM serves ALL EU Member States, ALL Non-EU European Countries across the European continent, ALL European Special Fiscal Territories, Islands, and Remote Areas. CURRENT PHASE & FUTURE SCALABILITY ROADMAP FOR WWW.EUROMALLS.EU.COM: Immediate Phase Deployment: On top of all products currently live on WWW.EUROMALLS.EU.COM, we are immediately injecting approximately 240,000+ new active SKUs: 90,000+ from DropXL, 50,000+ from Syncee, and 100,000+ from CJ Dropshipping, alongside our Spanish local supplier integrations. Future Progressive Scaling (600K to 1,000,000 SKUs): We will NOT load 1 million SKUs all at once onto WWW.EUROMALLS.EU.COM. We will scale progressively from our current base + 240K+ SKUs up to 600,000–1,000,000 active SKUs on WWW.EUROMALLS.EU.COM as we onboard additional suppliers in the future. Therefore, your architecture, database indexing, self-hosted search engine, and VPS/Dedicated hosting recommendation for WWW.EUROMALLS.EU.COM must handle today's 240K+ catalog smoothly while being 100% ready to scale to 1M SKUs without rebuilding WWW.EUROMALLS.EU.COM. MANDATORY PRE-WORK RULE: ZERO ALTERATION & FULL BACKUP FOR WWW.EUROMALLS.EU.COM Everything currently live on WWW.EUROMALLS.EU.COM, including existing products, pages, design, menus, plugins, settings, and existing data, is STRICTLY OFF-LIMITS. Do NOT delete, overwrite, or alter any existing content on WWW.EUROMALLS.EU.COM. Before touching anything on WWW.EUROMALLS.EU.COM, you MUST create and deliver a verified Full Off-Site Backup of WWW.EUROMALLS.EU.COM covering all files, database, and server snapshot. 7 MANDATORY TECHNICAL BLOCKS FOR WWW.EUROMALLS.EU.COM: BULLETPROOF INFRASTRUCTURE, ZERO LOCAL IMAGES & $0-COST SEARCH ENGINE: ZERO product images may be stored locally on WWW.EUROMALLS.EU.COM hosting to protect server inodes. Render all images on WWW.EUROMALLS.EU.COM externally via supplier CDN URLs or Cloudflare R2 / Amazon S3. Enable WooCommerce HPOS, Redis Object Cache, MySQL indexing, and Nginx/OpenLiteSpeed + PHP tuning on WWW.EUROMALLS.EU.COM for page loads under 1.5 seconds across our 240K+ immediate catalog and future 1M SKU expansion. Install a $0-license, self-hosted Open-Source search engine via Docker—specifically Typesense, Meilisearch, or OpenSearch/Elasticsearch—with strict RAM isolation from MariaDB to power search under 50ms and instant category/attribute filtering on WWW.EUROMALLS.EU.COM. Provide a clear hosting recommendation of exact VPS/Dedicated specs suitable for WWW.EUROMALLS.EU.COM with today's 240K+ SKUs and seamlessly upgradable to 600K–1M SKUs. HANDS-FREE MULTI-SUPPLIER CATALOG INJECTION & STAGGERED CRON SYNC: Inject 100% active eligible catalogs on top of existing WWW.EUROMALLS.EU.COM products: 90,000+ SKUs from DropXL for Spain domestic delivery ONLY, 50,000+ SKUs from Syncee Spain and EU warehouses, 100,000+ SKUs from CJ Dropshipping EU and China warehouses, plus our Spanish suppliers BigBuy, Nova Engel, Megasur, and Vinopremier. Disable wp-cron.php and configure staggered Linux Server Cron Jobs every 2 hours in micro-batches. Zero-stock items must hide or disable on WWW.EUROMALLS.EU.COM within 60 minutes. AUTOMATED FRONT-END DELIVERY BADGES NEAR ADD TO CART ON WWW.EUROMALLS.EU.COM: Syncee Spain, BigBuy, Nova Engel, Megasur, Vinopremier: " Fast Delivery: 24/48h" CJ Europe Warehouses & Syncee EU outside Spain: " Express Shipping: Delivery in 2-5 days (Europe Warehouse)" CJ China Warehouse: " International Shipping: Delivery in 15-20 days (China)" PAN-EUROPEAN GEOGRAPHIC LOCKS & VAT/OSS/EXPORT ROUTING: DropXL is strictly locked to SPAIN only on WWW.EUROMALLS.EU.COM. Any non-Spanish checkout on WWW.EUROMALLS.EU.COM, whether single or mixed cart, must block and display: "This product is not available for shipping outside Spain." All other suppliers on WWW.EUROMALLS.EU.COM must remain open across ALL EU and Non-EU European countries, islands, and European special territories serviced by supplier couriers. BULLETPROOF PRICING ENGINE & EXACT SUPPLIER SHIPPING RATES: Checkout shipping charged to the customer on WWW.EUROMALLS.EU.COM MUST match the exact live shipping rate returned by the supplier API, plus any Island or Remote Area surcharges. Exact 5-Step Pricing Formula for WWW.EUROMALLS.EU.COM: STEP 1 — Cumulative Base Cost: Cumulative Cost = Supplier Wholesale Cost + Exact Supplier API Shipping + Island or Remote Surcharges. STEP 2 — Cross-Border Advanced VAT Protection: IF shipping from outside Spain via CJ EU or Syncee EU AND the buyer is outside Spain, multiply Cumulative Cost by 1.21 for non-ROI/VIES VAT protection. STEP 3 — Payment Gateway & Processing Fee Absorption (3.5% + €0.30 fixed buffer): Inflated Base = (Cumulative Cost + 0.30) / (1 - 0.035) STEP 4 — Net Tiered Profit Markup Matrix (Applied to Inflated Base): €0.00 to €50.00: Multiply by 1.35 (35% Net Margin) €50.01 to €100.00: Multiply by 1.25 (25% Net Margin) €100.01 to €500.00: Multiply by 1.15 (15% Net Margin) €500.01 to €1,000.00: Multiply by 1.10 (10% Net Margin) €1,000.01 to €10,000.00: Multiply by 1.04 (4% Net Margin) STEP 5 — Dynamic Destination VAT / Export Tax Engine: For EU buyers, add exact destination EU VAT. For Non-EU European countries and ALL European Special Fiscal Territories—such as Canary Islands, Ceuta, Melilla, Heligoland, Livigno, Campione d'Italia, Åland Islands, Mount Athos, Büsingen am Hochrhein, French Overseas Departments, and all other out-of-VAT European special territories—strip VAT to 0% and inject live DUA/Customs clearance duty into the shipping/duty line item. Bulletproof Pre-Capture Kill Switch: Abort checkout on WWW.EUROMALLS.EU.COM and alert admin if net revenue ever drops below total costs. ADDRESS AUTO-COMPLETE & POSTCODE MISMATCH LOCK: Integrate Google Places or Loqate postal validation on WWW.EUROMALLS.EU.COM checkout. Block the "Place Order" button immediately if Country, City, Address, and Postcode do not match, such as selecting Spain with Madrid and postcode 08001. 100% HANDS-FREE CUSTOMER-FUNDED INSTANT SUPPLIER PAYMENT & FULFILLMENT LOOP: CRITICAL FINANCIAL RULE: Use the customer's incoming checkout payment directly via Stripe Connect Split Payments, Destination Charges, or automated instant settlement webhooks to pay the supplier's wholesale and shipping cost instantaneously. ONLY our clean net profit margin reaches WWW.EUROMALLS.EU.COM's bank account with zero capital outlay from us. Multi-supplier carts on WWW.EUROMALLS.EU.COM must split customer funds across each supplier automatically, push orders via API immediately, and sync tracking numbers back to mark orders "Completed" on WWW.EUROMALLS.EU.COM with automated emails and invoices—100% hands-free with zero human clicks. REALISTIC TIMELINE & BUDGET EXPECTATION: We know building a 100% automated, hands-free, bulletproof store on WWW.EUROMALLS.EU.COM requires 40 to 50 hours of active senior engineering over 10 to 14 calendar days. Bids promising unrealistic 15-hour delivery or copy-paste quotes will be rejected immediately. Payment will be structured across 4 verified technical milestones tied strictly to live acceptance tests on WWW.EUROMALLS.EU.COM. MANDATORY BIDDING FILTER: Start your bid with "WWW.EUROMALLS.EU.COM-1M" and state: Confirmation of full pre-work backup and zero alteration of existing products, pages, or design on WWW.EUROMALLS.EU.COM. Exact active engineering hours and total delivery days for this 240K+ SKU phase on WWW.EUROMALLS.EU.COM. Chosen $0-cost self-hosted search engine and RAM isolation method. Recommended hosting/VPS hardware specs for WWW.EUROMALLS.EU.COM with today's 240K+ SKUs and how it scales cleanly to 600K–1M SKUs. Exact method to execute 100% hands-free, instant customer-funded split payouts to suppliers. Concrete proof of 100K+ SKU bulletproof WooCommerce automation builds. Skills Required: WooCommerce, WordPress, API Integration, PHP, MySQL, Linux, Docker, Elasticsearch, Stripe Connect Split Payments, PayPal Split Payments, Payment Gateway Integration"

opportunities.title: Home Care Packaging Design
opportunities.description: I need a skilled FMCG packaging designer to develop a full visual identity and print-ready artwork for an entire line of household cleaning products. The range spans laundry detergent, dishwashing liquid, multi-purpose and bathroom cleaners, plus a few body-care SKUs that sit under the same brand umbrella. All cleaners will be sold in HDPE or PET bottles, with refill options offered in stand-up or spout pouches, so the graphics must translate seamlessly between rigid bottles and flexible packaging. I already have the dielines for both formats; what I need is a compelling, shelf-impacting design system that ties the whole family together while clearly differentiating each variant. Please send a detailed project proposal outlining your creative approach, milestones, estimated turnaround and revision policy. Attach any relevant portfolio pieces that show experience with similar bottle and pouch formats; I’m especially interested in work you’ve done for other FMCG or detergent brands. Deliverables expected: • Master design concept covering colour palette, typography and iconography • Front and back label layouts for each SKU, finalised in Adobe Illustrator (CMYK) • Print-ready PDFs with bleed, cutter guides and colour call-outs for both bottle labels and refill pouches • 3D mock-ups or high-resolution renders of each pack for presentation and e-commerce use Files should be fully editable, with linked fonts and images supplied. Designs will be signed off once they pass a printability check and accurately reflect the brand strategy discussed at kick-off. I’m ready to move quickly once I review the right proposal.

opportunities.title: Full-Stack Developer Required to Build Multi-Tenant SaaS CRM & ERP Platform
opportunities.description: **Project Type:** Development from Scratch **Platform:** Web SaaS + Mobile PWA **Engagement:** Fixed Price **Budget:** Open to Proposals ### Project Overview We are looking for an experienced full-stack developer or agency to design, develop, test, and deploy MYEVCRM, a complete cloud-based CRM, ERP, and business operations platform. Initially, the software will support EV infrastructure companies managing EPC projects, charger installation, commissioning, AMC, field services, finance, procurement, inventory, workforce, and charger monitoring. Our objective is to launch MYEVCRM commercially as a multi-tenant SaaS product with subscription plans, white-label branding, customizable modules, and secure independent client workspaces. The software must be developed from scratch, with a modern, user-friendly interface and complete source-code ownership. ### 1. Multi-Tenant SaaS & White-Label - Multiple independent companies with secure data isolation. - SaaS Super Admin and Company Admin dashboards. - Role-based permissions and multiple branches. - Trial, monthly, and annual subscriptions. - Module-based access and user licensing. - Client-specific logos, themes, and login pages. - Custom domains/subdomains. - Configurable menus, forms, and dashboards. - Branded documents and reports. - Tenant onboarding, activation, suspension, and data export. ### 2. CRM & Sales Management Lead management, customer records, sales pipeline, opportunities, follow-ups, quotations, proposals, contracts, sales orders, revenue forecasting, and sales dashboards. Leads must be convertible into projects or service contracts. ### 3. EV EPC Project Management - Multi-client, multi-project, and multi-site management. - Site surveys and readiness checklists. - BOQ, costing, budgeting, and margin analysis. - Vendor quotation comparison and work orders. - Project schedules and milestones. - Material planning and allocation. - Installation and commissioning tracking. - Daily Progress Reports (DPR). - Site photos and quality inspections. - Multi-level approvals. - WCC, HOTO, and project closure. - Project profitability and billing readiness. ### 4. AMC & Field Service Management - Charger and equipment asset registration. - Serial-number tracking and warranty management. - AMC contracts and renewals. - Preventive and breakdown maintenance. - Service ticket management and assignment. - SLA/TAT tracking and escalations. - Technician scheduling and service checklists. - Spare parts consumption. - Fault history and Root Cause Analysis. - Customer acknowledgement and ticket closure. - AMC performance and profitability dashboards. ### 5. Workforce & Technician Management The platform must manage four workforce categories: 1. Internal Team – Company employees. 2. Partner Internal Team – Partner company employees. 3. Freelance Technicians – Independent field technicians. 4. Local Vendors – Civil, electrical, and installation contractors. Features include onboarding, skills, certifications, geographic coverage, availability, job allocation, attendance, GPS check-in where permitted, task progress, photo evidence, quality checks, performance ratings, rate cards, freelancer payments, vendor settlements, and category-specific permissions. ### 6. Procurement & Vendor Management Vendor onboarding, RFQs, quotation comparison, purchase requisitions, POs, approval workflows, vendor rate cards, agreements, invoices, payment tracking, outstanding reports, and performance analysis. ### 7. Inventory & Asset Management Material masters, warehouses, stock inward/outward, transfers, project allocation, technician stock, serial-number tracking, spare parts, defective materials, returns, reorder levels, stock valuation, and asset lifecycle management. ### 8. Finance & Commercial Management Customer invoicing, vendor payables, receivables, payment tracking, GST invoice fields, project budgets, actual expenses, site-wise profitability, department P&L, gross margins, credit/debit notes, financial approvals, and outstanding dashboards. ### 9. EV Charger CMS Integration This is an important module for charging infrastructure monitoring and profitability. Required features: - Charger registration and CMS integration. - Live online/offline/charging/fault status. - Charging session history. - Electricity consumption in kWh. - Charger utilization, uptime, and downtime. - Charger fault monitoring and service ticket creation. - Charging tariffs and revenue. - Electricity purchase cost and operating expenses. - Site-wise and charger-wise profitability. - ROI and investment payback calculations. - Client-specific monitoring dashboards. - Daily, monthly, and yearly analytics. Support compatible OCPP 1.6J/2.0.1 where feasible. Historical CSV/Excel imports must also be supported. Live and imported data must be clearly differentiated. ### 10. Third-Party Integrations Future integration support for Tally, SAP, Zoho, Salesforce, other CRM/ERP platforms, accounting applications, and charger CMS. Support CSV, Excel, and XML import/export. Free APIs may be used when reliable and commercially permitted. Paid APIs or recurring third-party services require prior approval. All dependencies must be documented. ### 11. Customization & Automation - No-code form and custom field builder. - Configurable checklists and statuses. - Approval workflow builder. - Multi-level approvals. - SLA and escalation automation. - Notifications and reminders. - Custom report builder. - Configurable dashboards and widgets. ### 12. Documents & Reporting Centralized document management with upload, preview, download, version history, permissions, and audit logs. Dashboards for management, sales, EPC, AMC, workforce, finance, procurement, inventory, charger monitoring, consumption, revenue, and ROI. Reports must support filters and Excel/CSV/PDF export. ### 13. Mobile PWA & Offline Features The application must work on desktops, tablets, and mobile devices. Field engineers, freelancers, and vendors should be able to view jobs, update progress, complete checklists, upload photos, record materials, submit reports, and capture customer acknowledgements. Selected field workflows must support offline data capture with secure synchronization and conflict handling. ### 14. UI/UX Requirements Clean, modern, fast, and intuitive interface. Simple navigation, minimum clicks, easy forms, clear status indicators, responsive dashboards, and role-specific screens. UI/UX wireframes must be approved before development. ### 15. Technology & Security Open to suitable technology recommendations. Preferred options: React/Next.js, Laravel/Django/Node.js, PostgreSQL, Git, and cloud/VPS hosting. Mandatory security includes tenant data isolation, role-based access, secure authentication, server-side authorization, audit trails, encrypted communication, secure uploads, automated backups, recovery testing, and protection against common vulnerabilities. ### 16. Development Milestones Phase 1: Requirements, architecture, database, and UI/UX. Phase 2: Multi-tenant SaaS foundation and permissions. Phase 3: CRM and EPC management. Phase 4: AMC, workforce, and vendor modules. Phase 5: Procurement, inventory, and finance. Phase 6: White-label, subscriptions, and automation. Phase 7: Charger CMS, monitoring, and ROI analytics. Phase 8: Testing, deployment, and training. Phase 9: Complete source-code handover. Development must follow approved milestones with working demonstrations and acceptance testing. ### 17. Mandatory Source Code Ownership **Complete source-code and IP handover is non-negotiable.** Developer must provide: - Complete frontend and backend source code. - Database schema and migrations. - Git repository and commit history. - UI/UX design files. - Deployment scripts and configurations. - Integration code and documentation. - Technical and user manuals. - Testing and backup procedures. - Hosting and administrator access. - Third-party license details. Git repository and hosting should be under our ownership from Day 1. All newly developed project-specific IP must be transferred under the agreement. We must be free to modify, maintain, and commercialize the product independently. Final payment will depend on successful deployment, testing, and complete handover. ### 18. Testing & Support Functional, integration, security, performance, permission, and tenant-isolation testing are mandatory. Include a post-launch bug-fixing warranty and separate maintenance/support quotation. ### 19. Proposal Requirements Please provide: 1. Similar SaaS/CRM/ERP project examples. 2. opportunities.title: Crypto Order Flow Signal Module
opportunities.description: Looking for a Crypto Trading Bot / Signal Module Developer (Order Flow Focus)I’m looking for a specialist with real experience in cryptocurrency exchanges, streaming market data, and market microstructure.About the project: Development of a real-time module that analyzes the trade stream (aggressive orders) on futures markets and detects short-term market imbalances (impulses) to generate signals for manual trading. We work only with the most active coins.What needs to be done: Connect to WebSocket trade streams from Binance / Bybit (futures) Implement calculation of short-term aggressive volume imbalance (buy vs sell) Calculate current activity strength relative to recent average volume Track price change over a short time window Build a system of filters with configurable parameters (time windows and thresholds) Generate clean Long/Short signals with Telegram notification support Make parameters easily adjustable without code changes Requirements: Experience with crypto exchange WebSocket APIs (Binance, Bybit) Understanding of order flow, aggressive volume, delta, and time & sales Experience building real-time systems (not just simple parsers) Ability to write clean, maintainable code Experience with scalping or high-frequency signal systems is a strong plus Stack: Python preferred (asyncio / websockets). Open to other technologies if you have strong relevant experience.Important: I’m looking for someone who understands market microstructure and order flow — not just a general programmer. Ready to discuss details and full technical requirements after confirming relevant experience.Please include in your response: Brief summary of relevant experience Examples of similar projects (if available) Estimated timeline and budget range

opportunities.title: AI SEO Article Automation Tool
opportunities.description: Title: Build an AI Article Automation for an SEO Agency (Claude API + Bulk Brief Processing) About the Project I’m an SEO content manager. I produce a large number of articles and blogs each week for clients across Canada and the US in dental, legal, automotive, HVAC, real estate, construction and other industries. I need a simple automation that takes my client briefs and turns them into ready-to-review articles that read naturally and pass AI-detection checks. What the Input Looks Like Briefs arrive in this format, often many at a time: Campaign: 1 Article – 1 https://karmadentistry.ca/ Words Length: It should be at least 450 Words Primary Keyword: Cosmetic dentistry near me Secondary Keyword: Cosmetic dentistry near me in Mississauga Our Targeted Website: https://karmadentistry.ca/smile-rehabilitation/ A batch can contain several articles (450+ words) and blogs (250+ words) for one or more clients. What the Automation Must Do Parse briefs in bulk. I paste in or upload a full campaign, and the tool pulls out the client URL, word count, primary and secondary keywords, and target page for each piece. Research the client. It fetches the target page and homepage and pulls real business details (services, location, what makes them different). If a page doesn’t load, it should flag that clearly. It must never make up prices, stats, certifications or reviews. Generate the article using the Claude API, following my style rules: Warm, conversational, human tone, with contractions, rhetorical questions and varied sentence length No colons, semicolons, hyphens or dashes in the body copy Primary keyword in the title and worked in naturally, using synonyms instead of repeating it Bold subheadings for articles, a short bullet list under one or two of them, and a closing call to action Canadian English by default, with a setting to switch to American English for US clients Careful, consultation-focused wording for dental, medical, legal and aesthetics clients Run quality checks: word count, banned punctuation, keyword placement and repeated phrases. Check AI detection. It should connect to an AI-detection API (ZeroGPT, Originality.ai or similar). If a piece scores above my threshold (usually 5%), it rewrites automatically and checks again. Export the output to Google Docs or Word (one doc per campaign is fine), with each piece labelled by its keyword and ending with its word count. Nice to Have A simple interface (a web form, Google Sheet or desktop app) so I don’t have to touch code Saved style templates for each client A log of detection scores for each article Deliverables A working tool, plus source code that I own A short setup guide or video showing how to run it One round of testing and fixes on a real campaign of 5 to 10 articles

opportunities.title: Server-Side GTM, Stape, Magento 2 Tracking Specialist – Advanced GA4 & Meta CAPI
opportunities.description: I am looking for a highly skilled Tracking Specialist to completely overhaul and configure a reliable, accurate, and fully optimized tracking architecture for a luxury e-commerce brand. CRITICAL REQUIREMENT: You MUST have proven experience implementing advanced tracking within the Magento 2 ecosystem. I have previously hired highly-rated tracking experts whose implementations failed because they applied generic Shopify/WordPress approaches that were incompatible with Magento’s architecture, particularly regarding Content Security Policies (CSP), checkout functionality, and DataLayer structure. Please do not apply unless you have hands-on experience with Magento 2 checkout security, tracking integrations, and third-party extensions. My Tech Stack Platform: Magento 2 (v2.4.8) DataLayer: Magefan GTM Extension Consent Management: Anowave Cookie Consent Mode V2 Server-Side: Stape.io & Google Tag Manager (Web + Server containers) Destinations: GA4 & Meta CAPI Infrastructure: Cloudflare & PayU (3D Secure redirects) The Scope of Work I need a highly accurate, fully compatible tracking system with reliable data transmission between the browser, server-side GTM, Meta, and GA4. Your responsibilities will include: 1. Flawless Deduplication & Routing Fix the current split-routing architecture and establish a consistent event-tracking structure. Browser and server events must use properly synchronized event_id values to ensure reliable deduplication in Meta Events Manager, while maintaining accurate GA4 tracking without duplicate events. 2. Server-Side Cookie Persistence (EMQ) Properly configure the Stape Data Client and cookie handling to ensure identifiers such as _fbp, _fbc, _dcid, and FPIDP are correctly generated, transmitted, mapped, and persisted where applicable, in accordance with Anowave consent settings. Cookie lifetimes should be optimized within browser and privacy restrictions to maximize Event Match Quality (EMQ). 3. Complete Funnel Tracking Ensure all critical upper-funnel and lower-funnel events are accurately tracked, properly structured, and reliably transmitted: session_start, page_view, view_item, add_to_cart, begin_checkout (Meta: InitiateCheckout), add_shipping_info, add_payment_info, and purchase. Ensure the appropriate corresponding events are correctly mapped to Meta CAPI, with consistent event parameters and values. 4. Auto-Mapping & Data Hashing Ensure the Meta CAPI tag correctly handles auto-mapping for dynamic values, currencies, product information, and item arrays, without data loss or incorrect attribution. All available customer identifiers (email, phone, etc.) must be properly normalized and SHA-256 hashed where required before transmission to Meta. Implement reliable event handling to minimize data loss caused by network delays or temporary transmission failures. 5. Magento CSP & Checkout Handling You must understand how Magento 2's Content Security Policy (CSP) can restrict tracking requests, particularly on checkout and order success pages. I have a dedicated Magento backend developer on my team. Your responsibility is to identify and provide the exact domains/endpoints (e.g., scv.mydomain.com) that must be allowlisted through Magento's csp_whitelist.xml, where necessary. 6. Cloudflare Compatibility Ensure the GTM Server container receives the correct visitor IP address (e.g., via CF-Connecting-IP headers) when Cloudflare's proxy (orange cloud) is enabled. Identify any Cloudflare WAF, proxy, or security configurations that could interfere with tracking requests, and recommend appropriate exceptions where necessary. Payment & Quality Assurance Terms I am extremely detail-oriented and expect a thoroughly tested, professional implementation. This is a fixed-price contract, and payment will be released ONLY after the complete implementation has been successfully tested and verified. We will verify that: All critical funnel events are accurately received, properly structured, and consistently reported in GA4 and Meta. Browser and server-side Meta events are correctly matched and deduplicated, without unresolved configuration or deduplication warnings. The purchase event fires reliably and only once per transaction, including orders involving external 3D Secure payment redirects (PayU). Consent settings, cookie persistence, event parameters, and customer identifiers work correctly throughout the entire tracking process. To Apply Please start your proposal by answering these two technical questions: How do you handle Magento 2 CSP restrictions that may block tracking requests or prevent the Purchase event from being transmitted correctly on the success page? How do you ensure that Anowave Cookie Consent settings are correctly communicated to the Stape Data Client so that server-side identifiers and cookies are properly stored and maintained only when consent permits? I am looking for a genuine Magento 2 tracking expert who values precision, reliability, and attention to detail. If you have the required experience and can deliver a thoroughly tested implementation, I look forward to working with you.

opportunities.title: English Buildings Laser-Cut Kits
opportunities.description: I'm seeking creative talent to design 3D resin printable and laser-cut kits of English buildings for hobby model makers. I want to own these files, to be able to engrave and cut myslef. Both "full size" meaning a complete building, and half relief buildings to go up against a wall. I need to be able to get inside the buildings to add my own lights some detials, clearly they will need painting by myself or people I sell these pprinted or wooden kits too. I will also be adding lighting to the interior. Requirements: - Represent a mix of building types: historic landmarks (castles, churches), traditional homes, Retail outlets, hotels and some village and city structures. - Design detailed models with separate components for doors, windows, and roofs. - Ensure precision and quality suitable for intricate assembly. -hiding the connection parts for each wall, floor etc as much as possble, in brick and or block works. Ideal Skills and Experience: - Proficiency in design software for laser cutting. - Experience in architectural modeling. - Attention to detail and craftsmanship. I am able to supply some images of things I am looking for as well from time to time. Looking forward to your innovative designs!

opportunities.title: Reconstrucción PDF Escaneado Profesional
opportunities.description: Tengo un PDF de dos páginas que hoy luce claramente escaneado. Necesito transformarlo por completo para que aparente ser un documento digital original, listo para imprimir sin rastro de sombras, manchas ni pérdida de definición. Qué espero: • Reconstrucción visual total: corrige perspectiva, bordes y alineación, reescribe o limpia el texto para lograr nitidez absoluta y, si corresponde, vuelve a componer tablas, imágenes o sellos. • Resultado final en el mismo tamaño y resolución que el archivo fuente, entregado en PDF de alta calidad. • Preservación fiel de todo el contenido (texto, gráficos y estilos) con aspecto pulcro y profesional. Tu perfil ideal: – Dominio probado en retoque y restauración de documentos escaneados. – Experiencia demostrable realizando trabajos similares; muéstrame ejemplos concretos en tu propuesta. Entregables: 1. PDF final totalmente reconstruido y listo para impresión. 2. (Opcional) Archivo editable de apoyo si tu flujo de trabajo lo permite. Quedo atento a tu experiencia y a un breve resumen de cómo abordarías la reconstrucción de estas dos páginas.

opportunities.title: Go-to-Market Consultant / Business Development Expert for LokalNeeds
opportunities.description: LokalNeeds (https://lokalneeds.in) is a technology platform that helps local businesses get online with their own ordering links, without needing a website or app. The platform is developed and ready for launch, with Shop Ordering, WhatsApp Ordering, Subscriptions, Order Management, and Delivery Operator features. **We are looking for an experienced professional in India who can guide us through the next steps and help onboard our first local businesses.** **Responsibilities:** - Review the platform and recommend a practical launch strategy. - Identify which businesses and locations to target first. - Develop a plan to acquire the first 10–20 shops. - Guide and assist with real shop onboarding. - Gather feedback and recommend improvements. - Help establish a repeatable business acquisition process. **Requirements:** - Experience in business development, startup launches, or local merchant acquisition. - Knowledge of the Indian small-business market. - Ability to provide practical guidance and hands-on support. Please explain how you would launch LokalNeeds, whether you can assist with actual shop onboarding, and your expected charges. We prefer starting with a small pilot engagement.

opportunities.title: Ongoing SolidWorks 3D Design -- 3
opportunities.description: I’m looking to build a steady collaboration with a SolidWorks specialist who can jump in whenever new projects land on my desk. My day-to-day need is clear: 3D part and assembly design for mechanical parts and full machine assemblies. I will supply either a clean 3D SolidWorks model that needs refinement or a quick hand sketch with key dimensions; you turn that input into fully detailed, parametric assemblies ready for manufacturing. Typical workflow • Receive my reference (model or sketch) • Create or update the parametric part files and mate them into a clean, structured assembly • Generate manufacturing-ready drawings with views, dimensions, tolerances, and a basic BOM • Return the native SolidWorks files, STEP/IGES for sharing, and PDFs of the 2D drawings Acceptance criteria • Feature tree remains fully editable and logically organized • All mates solve without errors; no suppressed features in the final assembly • Drawings follow ISO or ANSI standards (I’ll specify per job) and clearly communicate GD&T where needed Quick communication and the ability to handle iterative feedback are more valuable to me than sheer speed. If you’re comfortable owning the 3D design side so I can focus on overall project management, let’s start with a small assignment and grow from there.

opportunities.title: Boost Dairy Orders via Social Media
opportunities.description: I run a local dairy brand that has already built trust with walk-in customers; now I need that same loyalty to translate into steady online orders and recurring home-delivery subscriptions. My priority is clear: drive measurable sales through Instagram, Facebook, and the order-taking power of WhatsApp. Here’s what I’m looking for: engaging, on-brand content that highlights our curated subscription boxes and flexible delivery bundles, paired with targeted ad campaigns and smart WhatsApp funnels that turn followers into paying customers. Creative reels, carousel posts, short video stories, and timely offers should all point directly to our checkout links or chat-to-order button. To keep things straightforward, I’ll judge success by two metrics—growth in completed online checkouts and the uptick in weekly delivery sign-ups—so please be comfortable setting baseline numbers, tracking them, and optimising as we go. If you have proven experience scaling e-commerce sales for FMCG or food brands on these exact channels, I’d love to see quick examples when we start chatting. Let’s turn social engagement into cartons on doorsteps.

opportunities.title: Unity 3D Multiplayer Grocery Game
opportunities.description: I’m building a cartoon-styled deception game in Unity where five online players share a single match: two play as store hunters while three pose as criminals carrying out secret missions before making a clean escape. The action unfolds inside a modern, clean supermarket with wide aisles, so visual clarity and polished 3D assets are important. FIRST PLAYABLE MILESTONE The very first thing I need is the grocery store map with functioning AI customers. These NPC shoppers must: • Pick up items from shelves • Use the checkout counters before leaving They should wander convincingly, queue when necessary, and generally create enough foot-traffic to make spotting the three criminals difficult for the hunters. Solid path-finding, simple state machines, and lightweight animation loops will be key here. ONWARD ROADMAP (context only) Once the AI-rich store environment feels alive, I plan to layer in the 5-player online roles, mission logic, detection and escape mechanics, and eventually port to multiple platforms. If we collaborate well on the prototype, there’s plenty more work ahead. Please send a brief note on your Unity multiplayer and AI experience, along with an estimated budget and timeline for delivering this first milestone. I’m ready to start as soon as we align on scope and schedule.

opportunities.title: WhatsApp Mould Repair Intake Automation
opportunities.description: I want to let my customers open mould-repair tickets straight from WhatsApp — in English, Hindi, Bengali or even Hinglish — without me touching any code. When they type “repair”, a guided form should appear, ask for: • mould number • company name and contact name • pickup address if needed • machine details and urgency level • a short defect description plus photos or video Once they hit send, the system must: 1. push every answer into a Google Sheet (one row per ticket) 2. create a uniquely numbered, one-page A4 PDF Job Card using the same data and attach the photos inside or as links 3. deliver that PDF instantly to both our office WhatsApp number and our chosen email address(es) — customers should not receive it 4. store the PDF in Google Drive for easy lookup Tech stack I would like to keep: WhatsApp Cloud API, n8n for the flows, and Google Sheets / Drive for storage. I have no prior coding experience, so I need you to build, test and document the whole workflow end-to-end, then walk me through it in a short hand-over session so I can add fields or change the email later. Please tell me about similar automations you have shipped with n8n or WhatsApp Cloud API and outline how many days you will need for: • initial setup • live testing with me on WhatsApp • final tweaks, documentation and basic training I will shortlist freelancers who demonstrate hands-on experience integrating WhatsApp Cloud API, dynamic PDF generation and Google Sheets.

opportunities.title: AI Children's Tale Video Creation
opportunities.description: I own a channel that repurposes public-domain children’s tales, myths, and fairy-tales into relaxing, long-form content. The next step is a series of videos—each running a full hour or more—ready for YouTube, TikTok, Facebook, and Instagram. Here’s what has to happen: • Select or confirm a public-domain story in the children’s/folklore space. • Craft a concise, engaging summary script that fills 60+ minutes when narrated. • Generate a natural-sounding AI voice-over (male or female—whatever best suits the tale). • Pair the narration with continuous, royalty-free or AI-generated scene changes so the visuals evolve steadily instead of staying static. • Edit, mix, and render in 1080p (horizontal for YouTube/Facebook, vertical for TikTok/Instagram). • Deliver the final MP4s plus separate audio and caption files so I can repurpose if needed. Any of the common AI toolchains—ChatGPT or Claude for summarising, ElevenLabs for voice, Midjourney/Stable Diffusion, Pika, Runway, CapCut, Premiere, or DaVinci for editing—are fine. What matters is a soothing flow: clear narration, smooth scene transitions, zero copyright risk, and a total runtime that never dips below one hour. Once the first video is approved, the same workflow can roll out to an ongoing series.

opportunities.title: GIS Digitization & Drone Map Processing
opportunities.description: I’m consolidating several datasets for a land-management project and need both sides of the geospatial workflow completed in one go. First, I’ll supply scanned cadastral sheets, survey notes, and other reference files; from those, please digitize every required feature—property boundaries and parcels, road and building footprints, plus rivers, vegetation classes, and other land-use areas—into clean, topologically sound vector layers. Each layer should carry clear, well-structured attribute tables and share a common, clearly documented CRS that will drop straight into ArcGIS or QGIS. In parallel, you’ll receive a batch of overlapping drone photos. Your task is to process them into a single, high-resolution orthomosaic that aligns perfectly with the new vector data. I’m not looking for 3D models this time; just a crisp, georeferenced stitched image suited for further mapping and measurement work. Please maintain sub-meter positional accuracy and document the full processing chain (software, control points, QA checks) so the results are reproducible. Deliverables • GeoPackage or Shapefile set containing all digitized layers • GeoTIFF orthomosaic, tiled if necessary for size • Metadata report detailing CRS, source references, accuracy assessment, and processing steps Provide a brief note on the tools you intend to use (e.g., ArcGIS Pro, QGIS, Agisoft Metashape, Pix4D) and an estimated turnaround time, and we can get started right away.

First, I’ll supply scanned cadastral sheets, survey notes, and other reference files; from those, please digitize every required feature—property boundaries and parcels, road and building footprints, plus rivers, vegetation classes, and other land-use areas—into clean, topologically sound vector layers. Each layer should carry clear, well-structured attribute tables and share a common, clearly documented CRS that will drop straight into ArcGIS or QGIS. In parallel, you’ll receive a batch of overlapping drone photos. Your task is to process them into a single, high-resolution orthomosaic that aligns perfectly with the new vector data. I’m not looking for 3D models this time; just a crisp, georeferenced stitched image suited for further mapping and measurement work. Please maintain sub-meter positional accuracy and document the full processing chain (software, control points, QA checks) so the results are reproducible. Deliverables • GeoPackage or Shapefile set containing all digitized layers • GeoTIFF orthomosaic, tiled if necessary for size • Metadata report detailing CRS, source references, accuracy assessment, and processing steps Provide a brief note on the tools you intend to use (e.g., ArcGIS Pro, QGIS, Agisoft Metashape, Pix4D) and an estimated turnaround time, and we can get started right away."

opportunities.title: AI-Powered Telegram Support Bot
opportunities.description: I need a Telegram bot that can step in whenever a user asks a question and instantly craft a helpful reply through an AI assistant rather than a fixed FAQ sheet. The user’s message should pass to the AI back-end (OpenAI, Claude, or any comparable model you recommend) and the generated answer must return to Telegram in a clear, friendly tone while keeping conversation context intact. How I picture the flow • User poses a question in a group, channel, or DM • Bot forwards it to the AI service, waits for completion • AI response is sent back to the user, tagged or threaded appropriately • Bot records basic interaction stats for me (/stats) Core expectations • Clean, reliable integration with Telegram Bot API • Context handling so back-and-forth conversations feel natural • Simple admin commands (/enable, /disable, /reset, /stats) • Secure management of all API keys via env vars or a config file • Deployment instructions for a small VPS or serverless setup I place high value on seeing your past work—especially bots or AI integrations you’ve already rolled out—so please include links or brief descriptions in your proposal. Code readability, meaningful comments, and a concise README are must-haves because I’ll want to fine-tune prompts and settings on my own later. If you can outline how you’d stage the milestones and mention any external services or libraries you plan to rely on, that will help me lock in a decision quickly.

opportunities.title: 3D Printable Prototype CAD Design
opportunities.description: Job Title: Reverse Engineering / Class-A Surface Designer – Two-Wheeler Body Panels (Scan-to-CAD) Project Overview We have 3D scan data (mesh) of the body panels of a Honda Activa 6G scooter. We need these converted into clean, editable CAD surfaces, then a redesigned outer skin built to a client’s design, while still fitting the existing chassis and neighbouring panels. Scope of Work Clean and prepare the scan mesh (noise removal, alignment, hole filling). Rebuild accurate NURBS surfaces and solids from the mesh (scan-to-CAD), with deviation analysis against the scan. Preserve all mating and mounting geometry exactly: clip points, screw bosses, panel edges, and gap/flush relationships with adjacent panels. Redesign the outer visible surface to the client’s reference design [sketches / renders / reference images will be provided]. Check panel gaps, clearances, and continuity (G1/G2 where required). Deliver the final CAD files and a deviation report. Required Skills Proven experience in scan-to-CAD reverse engineering of freeform/organic surfaces Surfacing software: Rhino, Alias, CATIA, Geomagic Design X, QUICKSURFACE, or equivalent Experience with automotive or two-wheeler body panels / plastic parts Knowledge of plastic part design basics: draft angles, wall thickness, rib and clip features Ability to work from scan data and 2D/3D design references Nice to Have Experience with injection-moulded parts (ABS/PP) Prototyping experience (3D printing for fit checks) Familiarity with Indian two-wheeler standards Deliverables STEP and IGES files (editable surfaces/solids) Native CAD file [Rhino/Fusion/other] STL of the redesigned panels for 3D printing Deviation analysis report (target: within ±[0.5] mm on mating areas) Inputs We Will Provide 3D scan mesh files [format: STL/OBJ/PLY] Client design references Key dimensions and chassis mounting information [if available]

opportunities.title: Urgent RCC Structural Detailers Needed
opportunities.description: Experienced Structural Detailers Required – RCCAD / AutoCAD / Revit | Urgent Project Project Type: Freelance / Part-Time / Project-Based Work Mode: Remote Project Availability: Immediate Minimum Engagement Period: 3 Months Project Overview We are seeking experienced freelance structural detailers to support our team on an urgent structural detailing project. We welcome applications from skilled independent freelancers and part-time professionals with proven experience in structural shop drawing preparation, reinforcement detailing, and coordination. The selected professionals will work on the assigned project scope and coordinate with our team to ensure accurate and timely delivery. Scope of Work The project involves the following activities: 1. Formwork Shop Drawings: Preparation of detailed formwork drawings for individual structural blocks. 2. Reinforcement Shop Drawings: Preparation of detailed reinforcement drawings for various structural elements. 3. Bar Bending Schedules (BBS): Preparation of reinforcement schedules, including bar marks, shapes, dimensions, and quantities. 4. MEP Coordination: Coordination and incorporation of MEP openings, sleeves, embeds, and penetrations. 5. Coordinate & Grid Integration: Working with EGSA87 coordinates and the project grid system to ensure accurate positioning and alignment. Required Skills & Technical Expertise - Proven experience in structural detailing and shop drawing preparation. - Strong knowledge of RCC formwork and reinforcement detailing. - Practical experience in preparing Bar Bending Schedules (BBS). - Understanding of MEP coordination and structural openings. - Familiarity with EGSA87 coordinates and project grid systems. - Proficiency in RCCAD, AutoCAD, and/or Revit. - Hands-on RCCAD experience for reinforcement detailing and BBS preparation will be an added advantage. - Ability to interpret structural drawings and project specifications independently. Project Availability & Mobilisation This is an urgent project requirement. We are looking for professionals who: - Can start immediately or within a short period after project award. - Can commit to a minimum continuous engagement period of 3 months. - Have sufficient working availability throughout the engagement period to meet project requirements. - Can work independently and coordinate with our technical team when required. - Can maintain high standards of drawing accuracy and quality throughout the project. Please mention your current availability and confirm your ability to commit to the minimum three-month engagement when applying. Application Requirements Interested professionals are requested to share: 1. A brief introduction and relevant professional experience. 2. Previous experience in formwork and reinforcement detailing. 3. Samples of completed structural shop drawings and BBS. 4. Software expertise (RCCAD / AutoCAD / Revit). 5. Current availability and earliest possible mobilisation date. 6. Confirmation of availability for a minimum three-month engagement. Closing Note We are looking forward to collaborating with experienced, reliable, and technically skilled structural detailers who can support this project on an urgent basis. Freelancers and part-time professionals with relevant project experience and the ability to commit for at least three months are encouraged to submit their applications. We look forward to a successful professional collaboration.

opportunities.title: Social Caption Automation Tool
opportunities.description: I’m looking to turn my rough ideas into polished, on-brand captions without spending hours at the keyboard. The goal is simple: save time managing my social channels by automating two pain points—generating fresh content ideas and writing short, punchy captions. Here’s what I need the tool to do: • Accept a brief prompt or topic (e.g., product launch, weekly tip). • Instantly return a bank of short social media captions tailored to that prompt, ready for Facebook, Instagram, X, and LinkedIn. • Offer a “content ideas” feature that suggests new angles or hooks when I’m stuck. • Let me copy, download, or export selected captions so I can paste them straight into my scheduler. A clean web interface or a lightweight desktop app is fine; what matters most is speed and ease of use. If you plan to harness GPT-4, Python, Node.js, or any other stack, just make sure the final build is reliable and easy for a non-technical user to maintain. Acceptance criteria: 1. I can enter a topic and immediately receive at least five unique, short captions. 2. Captions are free of spelling errors and stay within typical character limits for major platforms. 3. The app runs smoothly on both Mac and Windows (or is browser-based). 4. Clear hand-off: documented code, quick video walkthrough, and basic user guide. If you’ve built similar content-generation tools or have clever ideas to streamline this workflow even further, let’s chat.

The goal is simple: save time managing my social channels by automating two pain points—generating fresh content ideas and writing short, punchy captions. Here’s what I need the tool to do: • Accept a brief prompt or topic (e.g., product launch, weekly tip). • Instantly return a bank of short social media captions tailored to that prompt, ready for Facebook, Instagram, X, and LinkedIn. • Offer a “content ideas” feature that suggests new angles or hooks when I’m stuck. • Let me copy, download, or export selected captions so I can paste them straight into my scheduler. A clean web interface or a lightweight desktop app is fine; what matters most is speed and ease of use. If you plan to harness GPT-4, Python, Node.js, or any other stack, just make sure the final build is reliable and easy for a non-technical user to maintain. Acceptance criteria: 1. I can enter a topic and immediately receive at least five unique, short captions. 2. Captions are free of spelling errors and stay within typical character limits for major platforms. 3. The app runs smoothly on both Mac and Windows (or is browser-based). 4. Clear hand-off: documented code, quick video walkthrough, and basic user guide. If you’ve built similar content-generation tools or have clever ideas to streamline this workflow even further, let’s chat."

opportunities.title: Original Logo for Next Aura AI
opportunities.description: I’m looking for a designer to create an original logo for 'Next Aura AI Solutions', a technology company focused on AI automation, AI integration, and custom software development. I want something simple, elegant, and professional that looks just as good on a client proposal as it does on a modern website. I like compact geometric marks and clean lettering, but I’m open to other styles, including a softer abstract symbol, a custom wordmark, or a monogram. If you see a stronger direction for the brand, I’d love to see it. What I’m looking for - Make 'Next Aura' the focus, with 'AI Solutions' as a smaller secondary line. - Include a symbol or custom letterform that works on its own as a favicon or social media profile icon. - Make sure the logo works in plain black and white. Please avoid stock icons and generic AI imagery like brains or circuits. Deliverables - Two or three genuinely different initial concepts, shown on plain light and dark backgrounds. - The final full logo and standalone mark in full color, black, and white. - Editable vector source files, SVG and PDF exports, and high-resolution transparent PNGs. - Final color codes, font names, and details of any font licenses we’ll need. Please confirm that the final approved design will be original and that Next Aura AI Solutions will receive exclusive commercial rights to it. When applying, please share two or three relevant logos from your portfolio, your fixed price, your estimated timeline, and the number of revision rounds included. No custom sample is needed to apply.

opportunities.title: English & Hindi Romance Roleplay AI FB Messenger Bot Testing / Paid Chat bot conversation -- 5
opportunities.description: # AI Chatbot Conversation Tester – English + Hindi/Hinglish ## Job Overview I have already developed an **AI-driven role-play chatbot** designed for rich, natural, romance-focused conversations. I am now looking for freelancers to **use and test the chatbot extensively** so I can study how people interact with it and analyze deeper conversation patterns, emotional responses, engagement, and role-play behavior. **This is NOT a chatbot development job.** The AI chatbot is already developed. Your role will be to interact with the chatbot as a real user/character, follow the scenarios and instructions I provide, and have detailed, natural conversations with it. ## What You Will Do * Chat with my existing AI role-play chatbot for extended sessions. * Participate in romance, relationship, personal, and emotional conversation scenarios. * Follow a given storyline, character, or role-play situation. * Respond naturally and creatively rather than using repetitive or one-line responses. * Explore different directions that the conversation can take. * Test how the chatbot responds to different personalities, emotions, situations, and conversation styles. * Try different approaches to see how the chatbot's conversation changes. * Help identify interesting conversation patterns, unexpected responses, weaknesses, and areas where the AI can be improved. * Provide feedback after conversations when required. ## Language Requirements You **do not need perfect or professional English**. We are looking for people who can have **normal, natural human conversations in English**. You should also be comfortable with **Hindi, Hinglish, or a mix of English and Hindi**. For example, conversations may naturally switch between English, Hindi, and Hinglish, just like normal conversations between people. Formal/advanced English is **not required**. What matters most is that you can communicate naturally and understand the context of the conversation. ## Who We Are Looking For You may be a good fit if you: * Enjoy chatting and role-playing. * Can maintain a conversation for an extended period. * Are comfortable discussing romance, relationships, emotions, and personal topics. * Can understand and follow a character/storyline. * Have imagination and can respond naturally within a scenario. * Can try different conversation approaches instead of simply answering questions. * Can communicate comfortably in conversational English and Hindi/Hinglish. * Can provide clear feedback about your experience. Previous experience with AI chatbots, role-play, creative writing, customer research, or similar work is helpful but **not required**. ## Important This position is primarily about **conversation and user research**, not programming. You do **not** need to: * Develop an AI chatbot * Build APIs * Work with Facebook/Messenger APIs * Write backend code * Train an AI model * Build a story engine * Deploy software The chatbot and technical infrastructure are already in place. ## Payment **₹600 INR per hour of active conversation/testing.** The exact number of hours will depend on the testing requirements and the quality of the conversations. ## How to Apply Please briefly tell me: 1. small introduction about yourself, in your own words without using any AI or spell check 2. confirm you can work today - tell me which time? Shortlisted candidates will be given a test scenario to evaluate their conversation style. Start your proposal with your favorite color, so we know you have read this details. This is LIVE Roleplay kind of story telling chat -- and chat theme is girl to girl chat, so only female candidate are preferred. Candidate working from Laptop will be preferred.

opportunities.description: My team tracks key numbers in a master spreadsheet that lands on my desktop every morning. Right now I spend far too long copying the newest tab into yesterday’s workbook, merging rows, refreshing formulas, building trend calculations, and dressing it all up with charts before anyone even sees the numbers. I need a VBA-driven (or Power Query / Power Automate if you prefer) solution that will: • pull the fresh data from the incoming Excel file, • append it to our historical sheet, refreshing all formulas and trend calculations automatically, • generate a clean, date-stamped daily report file, and • fire off a concise email summary (totals and key variances) to our distribution list each morning. The heaviest time sinks for me today are the copy-and-combine steps, the rolling total and trend math, and the consistent chart and formatting work—so those all need to be hands-free when you’re done. Please build the automation so that scheduled execution is possible (Task Scheduler or equivalent) and leave clear, commented code so I can tweak ranges or add metrics later. Once the workflow runs end-to-end on my machine and the email summary lands in my inbox without manual touch, we’re good to sign off.

opportunities.title: 3D Flight Fare Promo Video
opportunities.description: I need a short 3D commercial that highlights our cheapest flight fares and speaks directly to young adults and students. The spot has to feel fresh and energetic, with one engaging animated character guiding viewers through the savings and a crisp, well-paced voice-over that is easy to understand even on mobile. Where it will appear • Square and vertical cuts for social media ads • Standard 16:9 for YouTube pre-roll and online placements • A silent-loop version for airport and travel-agency screens What I’ll look for in the final hand-off • 25–35 sec 3D animation rendered in 1080p (plus the extra aspect-ratio versions above) • English voice-over mastered and baked into the main edit, plus a clean track for future localisation • Layered project files (Maya, Blender, C4D or similar) and the final compiled video in MP4/H.264 • One round of revisions after first draft to fine-tune visuals, pacing or VO If you have a reel that shows lively character work and clear VO mixing, send it over so we can lock the style quickly and get this fare-promo flying.

opportunities.title: Lead-Focused Interior Reels Strategy
opportunities.description: Launching a premium interior-design styling consultancy, my first priority is converting Instagram and Facebook messages into booked consultations. Every Reel, carousel, or Story must spotlight our design process, materials, and behind-the-scenes thinking—using only select project images—to convey the ideology that sets us apart, then guide viewers straight to a WhatsApp chat for next-step discussions. You’ll own the pipeline from concept to conversion: develop monthly creative themes, direct or repurpose footage, edit in CapCut, Premiere Rush, or equivalent, write persuasive captions and hashtags, schedule through Meta Business Suite, and manage comments and DMs until they become warm leads. Interior-styling fluency is essential; the content has to sound as informed about marble veins and lighting temperatures as it is about algorithm trends. Monthly deliverables • 12 vertical Reels and 8 carousel/static posts, export-ready in the required ratios • Copy for captions, Stories, and automated replies, each CTA linking to WhatsApp • Lead-tracking sheet showing message volume, response times, and consultations booked • Performance report covering reach, engagement, saves, and conversion rate If you have proven results driving consultations for design or lifestyle brands, share links and metrics so I can gauge how your strategy could elevate this new venture.

opportunities.title: 3D Printed Cigar Tuck Cutter
opportunities.description: I’m developing a hand-powered tuck cutter that lets me press natural tobacco leaf wrappers onto a flat surface and quickly trim them with a clean, curved edge perfect for rolling cigars. I need a CAD design that I can send straight to my 3D-printer—no further tweaking—so attention to tolerances and blade alignment is essential. Because I work exclusively with whole, natural leaves, the geometry must accommodate their slight stretch while still producing a consistent rounded cut. The tool will be operated solely by hand; no clamps, hinges, or tabletop mounts are required, but an ergonomic grip and enough rigidity to prevent flex while pressing are important. Deliverables • Print-ready STL (plus STEP or native Fusion 360/SolidWorks file for future edits) • Exploded view or brief assembly note if multiple printed parts are involved • Recommended material settings (layer height, infill, orientation) to preserve edge sharpness • Confirmation that the cutting profile produces a smooth, curved strip the full width of a cigar wrapper I’ll test the first print and share feedback; quick revisions to fine-tune fit or edge profile may follow. Let’s create a simple, durable cutter that speeds up my rolling workflow and looks good on the bench.

opportunities.title: People Like Us - chat room website/app
opportunities.description: # Build a Website – People Like Us I want to build a social chat platform called **People Like Us**. The idea is simple: People can register, find chat rooms based on their interests and communicate with like-minded people. Think of WhatsApp groups, but with public rooms that anyone can join. The website should be very simple and easy to use, even for people who aren't tech-savvy. ### Main Features 1. **Registration:** Users can create accounts and profiles. 2. **Public Chat Rooms:** Different rooms for Startups, Business Ideas, Making Money, Dating, Jokes, Technology, Fitness and other interests. Anyone registered can join any public room. 3. **Private Chat Rooms:** Users can create private rooms and invite other people to discuss ideas. No fixed membership limit. 4. **Direct Messages:** Users can privately message anyone on the platform. 5. **Messaging:** Text messages, photos, videos and document sharing. 6. **Message Controls:** Users can edit and delete their messages, reply to messages and search conversations. 7. **Room Discovery:** Search and explore rooms based on interests. 8. **Notifications:** Notify users about new messages, replies and mentions. 9. **Moderation:** Users can report spam or inappropriate behaviour. Admins can review reports and block accounts when necessary. 10. **Admin Dashboard:** I should be able to manage users, rooms, reports and the overall platform. ### Donation System The platform will be completely free. There will be no subscription or joining fees. I want a voluntary donation button so people can support the platform. Donors can optionally display their name, photo and a short story about what they achieved through the platform. Donation amounts will always remain private. ### Design I want a modern, attractive and very simple interface, similar to WhatsApp in ease of use. The website should work smoothly on computers and mobile phones. ### Important The platform should be built with scalability in mind because I eventually want thousands or millions of users. I want complete ownership of the website, source code, database and hosting accounts. Please share your previous work, estimated development cost and time required to complete this project.

opportunities.title: WhatsApp Business API Debugging
opportunities.description: I need an experienced developer to jump into my existing WhatsApp Business API setup, trace whatever is blocking it, and get everything flowing smoothly again. At the moment the integration is unreliable—sometimes messages never leave, delivery callbacks stall, and the API connection occasionally drops. I’m looking for someone who can isolate the root cause, patch the code or server configuration as needed, and prove stability with real-world tests. To keep us aligned, here’s what I expect you to hand over: • Fully functional send-and-receive cycle verified with test numbers • Webhook events firing consistently for all message statuses • Clean, well-commented code or configuration notes outlining the fix • Quick guide summarising any credentials, endpoints, or tokens I must refresh You may work in the language or framework of your choice—as long as it works with Meta’s current Business Cloud API specs—and can run on my cloud host. Please outline your relevant experience with WhatsApp Business API, signal how soon you can begin, and tell me roughly how long the full diagnostic and repair should take.

opportunities.title: Long-Term 2D Design Partner
opportunities.description: I’m setting up a three-year collaboration with one versatile designer who can turn a constant stream of ideas, sketches, and mark-ups into crisp, presentation-ready 2D drawings and designs. Most weeks I’ll hand you rough hand-sketches, photo references, or red-lined PDFs and ask for clean, scaled drawings that are accurate enough for engineers yet attractive enough for client decks. The work is varied—one month it may be detailed building layouts, the next a set of technical product diagrams or marketing visuals—so fluency across common 2D toolsets is essential. AutoCAD for precise line work, Adobe Illustrator or Photoshop for polished graphics, and the ability to export everything to whatever final format the project dictates (print-ready PDFs, layered source files, or native CAD) keeps the pipeline flowing smoothly. Communication and consistency matter more than flashy portfolios. I value: • Fast, reliable turnarounds within agreed timelines • Clearly organised layers, styles, and naming conventions • Easy revision cycles: you accept mark-ups, return updated files, and note what changed • A proactive eye for detail—spotting dimension clashes or layout issues before they become problems Although the bulk of the load is 2D, a comfort level with quick 3D mock-ups or renders is a welcome bonus and could grow into a larger part of the role as our product lines evolve. If you’re ready for steady, predictable work and enjoy refining drawings until they’re spot-on, let’s talk about the first assignment and set milestones for the months ahead.

opportunities.title: Full Home Automation System Design
opportunities.description: I need a full, end-to-end design for a residential automation system that puts intelligent lighting and climate control at its core. The project should map out how every switch, dimmer, sensor, thermostat, and actuator ties into a single backbone, ensuring seamless daylight-responsive dimming, scene presets, and temperature scheduling that adapts room-by-room. Alongside comfort control, I want the plan to incorporate two key security layers: smart cameras with motion-triggered alerts and smart door locks that let me manage visitor access rules centrally. All interaction will happen through elegant wall-mounted touch panels, so the design must specify hardware locations, interface flow, and the low-latency network needed to keep every screen snappy. Please deliver • System architecture diagram showing hubs, panels, and device endpoints • Wiring / network schematics ready for an electrician or low-voltage contractor • Bill of materials with model numbers for lighting modules, thermostats, cameras, locks, panels, and any required gateways • Touch-panel UI mock-ups that illustrate lighting scenes, climate set points, camera views, and lock status • Integration notes (e.g., KNX, Zigbee, Z-Wave, or IP) and configuration steps so an installer can bring the system online without guesswork The house is new-build, so you can assume clean-sheet cabling is possible. Keep the design modular so additional smart appliances or voice assistants could be added later, but focus your detail on the scope above.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40818717, publicado hace 13 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: USD 30 - 250.

opportunities.description: Se busca un especialista con experiencia comprobable en GoHighLevel para desarrollar una máquina de ventas y CRM integral para una correduría de seguros en Colombia. El objetivo es construir una plataforma robusta que no solo funcione como CRM administrativo, sino que también automatice la captación, calificación y distribución de prospectos, con la capacidad de ser replicada para otras agencias de seguros. Los componentes clave a desarrollar incluyen: 1. Captación y embudo de ventas: - Diseño e implementación de landing pages de calificación y páginas de agradecimiento. - Configuración de formularios conectados a campañas de anuncios en Meta (Facebook/Instagram). - Creación de un pipeline de ventas con etapas definidas: prospecto, contactado, cotizado, negociación, ganado/perdido. 2. Agente de IA para WhatsApp: - Desarrollo de un agente de inteligencia artificial capaz de responder a prospectos en segundos, calificarlos y agendar citas automáticamente. - Implementación de lógica para transferir leads 'calientes' a un asesor humano. 3. Distribución automática de prospectos: - Configuración de un sistema de asignación de leads tipo 'round-robin' o por turnos entre asesores o agentes. - Establecimiento de reglas de distribución basadas en el ramo de seguro (vida, salud, autos, hogar, exequias, etc.), Ubicación geográfica o disponibilidad del asesor. - Asegurar la no duplicación de leads, con notificaciones automáticas vía WhatsApp a los asesores y seguimiento en tiempo real. - Posibilidad de establecer límites de leads por asesor o paquete. 4. CRM de clientes y pólizas: - Creación de fichas de cliente detalladas que incluyan información de pólizas, aseguradora, ramo, vigencia, prima y estado. - Implementación de campos personalizados y alertas de renovación (60, 30 y 15 días antes). - Funcionalidades para el manejo de cartera, incluyendo recordatorios de pago y seguimiento de cobro. 5. Automatizaciones y flujos de trabajo: - Desarrollo de secuencias automatizadas de WhatsApp, SMS y correo electrónico para bienvenida, seguimiento, post-venta, renovación y reactivación. - Configuración de recordatorios de citas (24 horas, 1 hora, 10 minutos antes). - Creación de flujos de correo con plantillas personalizables. 6. Informes y dashboards: - Generación de informes y paneles de control para visualizar leads por fuente, tasa de conversión por etapa, ventas por asesor/ramo, estado de cartera, renovaciones y comisiones. 7. Modelo multi-agencia: - Estructuración del sistema para permitir la creación de subcuentas o 'snapshots' que faciliten la replicación del sistema a otras agencias de seguros, permitiendo la administración independiente de cada una. Se requiere experiencia sólida en la configuración de workflows, pipelines, agentes de IA e integraciones dentro de la plataforma GoHighLevel. Categoría: Programación y Tecnología Subcategoría: Programación Web ¿Cuál es el alcance del proyecto?: Crear un nuevo sitio personalizado

opportunities.title: One Hour Blender Animation Lesson
opportunities.description: In a single, live one-hour session over screen-share, I want to get comfortable with Blender’s animation basics. Blender 5.2 is already installed on my laptop; what I need now is practical, guided practice. The focus of the lesson is creating basic animations—specifically moving and rotating simple objects. Please walk me through the essential workspace controls, keyframing, and the timeline so that by the end of the hour I can confidently set up and play a short object-motion sequence on my own. We can meet through Zoom, Google Meet, or any similar tool that allows screen sharing and clear audio. I’ll share my screen so you can demonstrate each step directly within my own Blender interface and watch me repeat it. By the end of the call, I expect to: • Understand how to navigate the viewport and manipulate objects. • Animate at least one object’s position and rotation from start to finish. • Export or preview the result smoothly. If you have sample .blend files that illustrate object motion, feel free to bring them; otherwise we’ll create a scene from scratch.

opportunities.title: AI Face Replacement with Lip-Sync
opportunities.description: I have a 20-minute talk, “Who Am I? – What Shapes Our Life” (https://youtu.be/x_Zn4ilnJrM), where my on-camera image is disappointingly low-res. I’ve already produced a crisp AI render of myself and want that version to appear every time I’m on screen—throughout the entire video—while the background and framing stay exactly as recorded. What I need: • Track my face in all shots and replace it with the supplied AI portrait. • Lip movements, micro-expressions, and timing must match the original speech as closely as possible so the swap is unnoticeable. • Keep audio, pacing, and all other visual elements intact. Deliverables: • Final 1080p (or higher) video with the new face seamlessly integrated. • Project file or layered comp so I can adjust captions later if needed. I will provide the AI image plus any reference frames the moment we start. Please outline briefly which tools or workflow you’ll use (e.g., DeepFaceLab, Runway, After Effects + tracking suite) and how long you’ll need once assets are in hand. I’m keen to begin right away.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40818599, publicado hace 16 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: USD 10 - 30.

Agradeceré comentarios en el vídeo o notas dentro del archivo si utilizas atajos o técnicas particulares.

opportunities.title: App móvil venta productos
opportunities.description: Quiero lanzar una aplicación móvil que me permita vender productos físicos de forma sencilla y segura. La idea es que el usuario pueda explorar un catálogo, añadir artículos al carrito, pagar dentro de la app y luego hacer seguimiento de su pedido. Me muevo con rapidez y disfruto de la tecnología, por lo que busco un desarrollo limpio, escalable y bien documentado. Funcionalidades clave • Catálogo con fotos, descripciones y stock en tiempo real • Carrito de compras y proceso de checkout optimizado • Pasarela de pago segura (tarjeta y, si es posible, billeteras digitales) • Notificaciones push para confirmar pedidos y actualizaciones de envío • Panel de administración para gestionar inventario, precios y promociones • Módulo de seguimiento de pedidos con número de guía • Estadísticas básicas de ventas y clientes Alcance técnico Prefiero una solución multiplataforma (Flutter o React Native) para publicar tanto en iOS como en Android, pero acepto propuestas nativas si justifican ventajas claras. El código debe quedar en un repositorio Git, acompañado de instrucciones de despliegue y un breve manual de usuario interno. Entregables 1. Código fuente completo y documentado 2. Build firmada lista para App Store y Google Play 3. Panel de administración funcional (puede ser web) 4. Archivo de configuración y guía de instalación Valoro la comunicación ágil, los commits frecuentes y la posibilidad de añadir funciones extra más adelante (por ejemplo, cupones o programa de fidelidad). Si tienes experiencia en e-commerce móvil y pasarelas de pago, será un plus importante.

opportunities.title: Descompilar y recompilar juego Gamebryo
opportunities.description: Cuento con el ejecutable original de un juego de mi infancia basado en Gamebryo con DirectX 9. Antes de empezar a retocar textos, gráficos o mecánicas, lo primero que necesito es un flujo estable de ingeniería inversa: obtener el código fuente legible, reorganizarlo en un proyecto que compile sin errores y generar un nuevo .exe funcional que se comporte exactamente igual que el original. Proporciono el .exe y los recursos actuales; también tengo identificadas varias DLL asociadas al motor. El objetivo inicial es: • Descompilar completamente el binario y cualquier librería vinculada • Reestructurar y documentar el proyecto de modo que pueda abrirse y compilarse en un entorno moderno (Visual Studio + SDK DirectX 9, por ejemplo) • Entregar un build reproducible con instrucciones paso a paso y las herramientas empleadas Cuando el re-ensamblado sea fiable, planeo avanzar hacia la localización de textos y ajustes ligeros, por lo que valoraré un código claro, comentarios donde se descubran offsets críticos y scripts que automaticen el proceso. Aprecio experiencia previa con Gamebryo, IDA Pro, Ghidra o herramientas similares, pero lo importante es obtener un proyecto mantenible y una compilación idéntica al ejecutable original.

opportunities.title: Guía y tutoría MATLAB-EEGLAB
opportunities.description: Nunca he usado MATLAB, pero necesito ejecutar EEGLAB para analizar registros de EEG que ya tengo en formato EDF/BDF. Busco a alguien que primero investigue y documente cómo integrar correctamente MATLAB con EEGLAB en mi sistema y, después, me enseñe a utilizar el flujo de trabajo básico para: • Instalar y configurar MATLAB, las toolboxes necesarias y la versión más estable de EEGLAB. • Importar archivos EDF/BDF a EEGLAB sin pérdida de canales ni metadatos. • Aplicar pasos de limpieza esenciales (filtros, detección/rechazo de artefactos, ICA) sobre datos previamente adquiridos. • Ejecutar análisis estándar (marcar eventos, crear epochs, calcular ERPs o espectros de potencia) con scripts reproducibles. • Guardar y exportar resultados y gráficos para futuras publicaciones. Quiero un paquete que incluya: – Un documento paso a paso con capturas y fragmentos de código comentado. – Una breve guía de conceptos básicos de MATLAB orientados a EEGLAB (funciones, rutas, variables, scripts). – Al menos dos sesiones en línea en vivo donde revisemos la instalación y corramos un ejemplo real con mis datos. – Respuestas a preguntas posteriores por escrito mientras practico. Valoraré que la explicación sea clara para principiantes y que el código quede listo para escalar a análisis más complejos en el futuro.
